criteria.criterion_text: Patients with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes (less than 10 years)
criteria.reasoning: Known fact: Condition 0f2e975a-ba64-1b75-a602-7d9436c7fb47 is coded http://snomed.info/sct 44054006 (display/text 'Diabetes'), with raw clinical status 'active', verification 'confirmed', and onset_date and recorded_date both 2017-12-11T19:37:30-05:00. It is the only retained Condition with this code, so under the supplied rule its recorded_date, 2017-12-11, is the documented-history start. Applicability: the source display does not state the diabetes type. The type 2 attribution rests on the standard SNOMED CT meaning of 44054006, not on file text. Documented history as of 2021-11-30 is 1,450 days (about 3 years 11 months), which is under 10 years. 'Newly diagnosed' is read through the parenthetical '(less than 10 years)'. This is documented history only, not proof of the true first-ever diagnosis date. Same-day context: HbA1c (http://loinc.org 4548-4) of 7.56 % on 2017-12-11T19:37:30-05:00, and two MedicationRequests for RxNorm 860975 '24 HR Metformin hydrochloride 500 MG Extended Release Oral Tablet' authored 2017-12-11 (raw_status 'stopped'; orders only). Record inconsistency: Prediabetes (SNOMED 15777000, active, confirmed) and Hyperglycemia (SNOMED 80394007, active, confirmed) were recorded on 2018-12-17T19:37:30-05:00, after the diabetes Condition. Later HbA1c values were 6.06 % (2018-12-17), 5.47 % (2019-12-23) and 5.62 % (2020-12-28). These do not negate the coded diagnosis but need source review. Preliminary label: MET, with the caveats above.

criteria.criterion_text: Significant comorbidities linked to worsening diabetes (such as renal failure, previous myocardial infarction, retinopathy, signs or symptoms of severe diabetic neuropathy or diabetic foot ulcers), severe osteoarthritis or as judged by the attending physician.
criteria.reasoning:
Logic: this is an OR clause. The exclusion applies (MET) if any component applies. NOT_MET requires evidence that every listed component is absent and that no physician judgment applies.

Renal failure: no renal-failure Condition is among retained Conditions. eGFR (http://loinc.org 33914-3) was 99.05 mL/min/{1.73_m2} on 2018-12-17, 156.18 on 2019-12-23 and 137.06 on 2020-12-28. Creatinine (38483-4) was 1.3, 1.17 and 1.19 mg/dL on the same dates. Microalbumin Creatinine Ratio (14959-1) was 4.6, 12.05 and 8.68 mg/g. These pre-assessment values do not indicate renal failure on those dates. However, the latest is from 2020-12-28, about 11 months before assessment_date, and they are not contemporaneous trial measurements.

Previous MI, retinopathy, signs or symptoms of severe diabetic neuropathy, diabetic foot ulcers and severe osteoarthritis: no retained coded Condition, Observation or Procedure documents them. No eye examination or foot/neuropathy examination is among processed resources. Encounter, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference and CarePlan resources were not processed. Absence here is missing evidence, not negative history.

Other documented conditions: 'Body mass index 30+ - obesity (finding)' (SNOMED 162864005, active), 'Metabolic syndrome X (disorder)' (237602007, active) and 'Hypertriglyceridemia (disorder)' (302870006, active) are not among the listed examples. Whether any counts as a 'significant comorbidity linked to worsening diabetes' is for the attending physician.

The investigator-discretion component cannot be evaluated offline. Status: UNKNOWN.
